## `server` — `@mediabase/server`

本行陈述:

```yaml
root: !!js ctx.appPaths.root
port: !!js ctx.env.rawNum('PORT')
distIndex: !!js ctx.env.str('DIST_INDEX')

  readonly: !!js ctx.env.flag('READONLY')
  allow: !!js ctx.env.list('ACL_ALLOW')
  deny: !!js ctx.env.list('ACL_DENY')
```

`Config` 接受的字段:

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `root` | string | yes |  | application root (packaged app: its resource root) |
| `host` | string | no | "127.0.0.1" |  |
| `port` | number | no | 3088 | listen port; 0 lets the OS pick one |
| `distIndex` | string | no |  | absolute path of the client index.html |
| `token` | string | no |  | shared secret; empty/absent = no auth (local trust boundary) |
| `acl.readonly` | boolean | no |  | refuse every method declared mutates |
| `acl.allow` | array<string> | no |  | allow list (prefix.* wildcards) |
| `acl.deny` | array<string> | no |  | deny list; wins over allow |
| `crossOriginIsolation` | boolean | no |  | serve COOP/COEP/CORP for SharedArrayBuffer |
